accepted_gaps.title: Unconditional critical-norm control
accepted_gaps.statement: Energy estimates do not prove a bound in a continuation-critical norm for arbitrary smooth data.
accepted_gaps.downstream_constraint: A proposed solution must state an unconditional critical or stronger a priori estimate.

accepted_gaps.title: Uniform vortex-stretching depletion
accepted_gaps.statement: No proved scale-uniform inequality controls vortex stretching by dissipation in all potential concentration cylinders.
accepted_gaps.downstream_constraint: Numerical attenuation can motivate, but cannot substitute for, the required inequality.

accepted_gaps.title: Nontrivial ancient-profile exclusion
accepted_gaps.statement: Known compactness and Liouville mechanisms do not exclude every profile compatible with arbitrary hypothetical blow-up.
accepted_gaps.downstream_constraint: The compact limit class, nontriviality, and rigidity theorem must be matched exactly.

accepted_gaps.title: Pressure-safe localization
accepted_gaps.statement: A localized velocity argument must bound pressure and far-field strain without a hidden global regularity premise.
accepted_gaps.downstream_constraint: Every local estimate must list pressure decomposition, cutoffs, and tail terms.

accepted_gaps.title: Auditable proof-claim adjudication
accepted_gaps.statement: Public solution declarations lack a workflow-level proof-obligation discharge.
accepted_gaps.downstream_constraint: Claims remain unverified until the unrestricted formulation and every analytic bridge are independently checked.

rejected_inferences.inference: A finite simulation or grid cutoff rules out blow-up.
rejected_inferences.reason: The Millennium problem is a continuum, all-scale theorem.

rejected_inferences.inference: Partial regularity proves the singular set is empty.
rejected_inferences.reason: A small singular set may still be nonempty.

rejected_inferences.inference: A theorem for axisymmetric, rotating, thin-domain, or small-data flows proves the general problem.
rejected_inferences.reason: Those are strict subclasses with additional structure.

rejected_inferences.inference: A repository declaration solves the problem merely by declaring a global bound.
rejected_inferences.reason: The norm, hypotheses, proof of coercivity, and full limit argument remain to be audited.
